name: Comicon Bergamo
blurb: Italian pop-culture festival in Bergamo, the sister event of Napoli Comicon, with comics and games guests, exhibitions and a cosplay competition.

editions.evidence: Homepage news item: 'L'appuntamento e fissato per la quinta edizione di COMICON Bergamo, in programma dal 25 al 27 giugno 2027' (news/905, published after the 2026 edition closed); footer text on the same site gives the venue as 'Fiera di Bergamo'.

notes: Seed URL www.comicon.it is the Napoli edition's domain; Bergamo's own site is bergamo.comicon.it. The homepage still displays the concluded June 26-28, 2026 edition and its guest lineup (2027 guests are not yet posted), so guests is 'none-yet' for the 2027 edition even though the 2026 lineup is visible on the page. Organizer legal name not confirmed from an official source, left blank. Cover hero:0 is the main rotating banner image; other hero images are a store banner (SVG), cosplay-challenge registration banners and shop photos, so were skipped.
